audit.notes: Full read of dist/*.js (31.7 KB) + rules/*.yaml (9 tool-poisoning + 16 code rules). Static: no code of the scanned target is executed. The only network/child_process path is dist/resolve.js (npm pack / git clone) and the gate never reaches it: the engine is always invoked on a gate-materialized local directory (regular files only, symlinks refused). Known gaps covered by gh-rules.yaml: bidi overrides, instruction-boundary breaks, authority claims, inputSchema description poisoning. Runs as subprocess with minimal env (no credential variables).
